themes.evidence: We conduct our business consistent with all applicable laws and are honest in our dealings with customers, employees, shareholders, partners, suppliers, competitors and the community.

We maintain an environment built on mutual respect, openness and individual integrity. This includes our concern for all people who touch or are touched by our company: customers, employees, shareholders, partners, suppliers and communities.
We pursue pharmaceutical innovation, provide high quality products and strive to deliver superior business results.

linguistic_shift: We have added new values and reinforced existing ones, such as Integrity and Respect for People, and introduced a new value, Innovation.
analyst_notes: Ensure the new values are reflected in the company's internal policies and practices.
